name: first_sortie_tap_to_sail_local_route_observer

observation_rules.intent: Only a water-tap route while undocked in LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT; never an objective or loot click.
observation_rules.motion: A locally sampled ShipMotor changes position while moving toward its unchanged water target; this is not M268 authoritative motion.
observation_rules.arrival: After observed local motion, PlayerShipInput ends its active route within its existing 1.35 unit stopping radius; no new speed, reload or damage balance value.
observation_rules.interruption: Different route, docking, sinking, missing player/input, authority change or stopping without observed arrival.
observation_rules.truth: All route stages are QA presentation only; server acceptance and trusted native device evidence are separate.

placeholder_strategy: Reuse existing complete ship GLBs and native Tap-to-Sail route marker; no new modular ship mesh or center-chart overlay.
